items.expected: The final answer connects computed polarization and competing-site evidence to the six-membered product preference under the stated NBS experiment. Use 7 only with its enzyme-condition boundary; its product mixture is not a same-condition NBS control. Do not claim reactant MEP uniquely proves a microscopic path or that the proposed Thorpe–Ingold contribution is established. No additional points for quoting supplied yields.
